0.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_KYUSEI_000_000
0.description: So, the first ten floors posed little obstacle to our intrepid friend. Or should I say, the Warrior of Light?

1.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_KYUSEI_000_001
1.description: After all, this is what Eorzeans call such a hero, is that not so? A title befitting the one who triumphed over the Black Wolf of Garlemald.
1.translation_description: Dopotutto, è così che gli eorzeani chiamano <hex:020829E905FF13756E2765726F696E6120636F6D65206C6569FF11756E2065726F6520636F6D65206C756903>, non è vero? Un titolo che si addice a chi ha sconfitto il Lupo Nero di Garlemald.

2.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_RASHO_000_002
2.description: I had no idea Western affairs were within your purview. Just how far does your reach extend?
2.translation_description: Non pensavo che gli affari dell'Occidente fossero di tua competenza. Fin dove arriva la tua influenza?

3.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_RASHO_000_003
3.description: Hmph. You've too many secrets for my liking, but very well. Have it your way.
3.translation_description: Hmph. Hai troppi segreti per i miei gusti, ma sia. Come preferisci.

4.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_KYUSEI_000_004
4.description: And have it my way I shall. For this is merely the beginning.
4.translation_description: E io farò proprio come voglio. Questo è solo l'inizio.

5.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_KYUSEI_000_010
5.description: The challenger has conquered the twentieth floor, and it is only a matter of time before <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> arrives to confront you. May I suggest that─
5.translation_description: <hex:020840E905FF1E4C276573706C6F7261747269636520686120636F6E717569737461746FFF1D4C276573706C6F7261746F726520686120636F6E717569737461746F03> il ventesimo piano e non passerà molto prima che <hex:02080DE905FF046C6569FF046C756903> arrivi ad affrontarti. Ti suggerirei di─

6.name: TEXT_DUNGEONDEEPDUNGEON2_00000_KYUSEI_000_011
6.description: Yes, quite. In that case, I shall leave you to attend to your duties, as I return to mine. Fare thee well.
6.translation_description: Sì, esatto. Allora ti lascio ai tuoi compiti, mentre torno ai miei. Addio.
